title: morus mongolica var. yunnanensis
intro: Morus mongolica var. yunnanensis, commonly known as the Yunnan mulberry, is a plant species in the Moraceae family. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the mountainous regions of Yunnan Province in China. The health benefits of Yunnan mulberry include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as cardiovascular disease and cancer. The bioactive constituents of Yunnan mulberry include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
